The '''Delta-C Tri-Thruster''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engine]] that could travel through [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] at a maximum speed of 95% [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]]. It was manufactured by [[Hamilton Engineering]] and it cost 1,000 [[Wupiupi/Legends|wupiupi]].<ref name="JGG">''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]''</ref>
